verdict.rationale: The California Secretary of State is a government business-filing and records portal. It does not host user-built automations, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows any automation feature. Document preclearance and User Access controls are filing-review and permission features, not automation version control, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
